package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for middleware_uses_global_logger_or_config_singleton: Middleware that depends on mutable globals instead of injected config and logger instances.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var GlobalLogger = log.New(os.Stdout, "[app] ", log.LstdFlags|log.Lshortfile)

type AppConfig struct {
	MaxBodySize int64
	APIKey      string
	DebugMode   bool
}

var GlobalConfig = AppConfig{
	MaxBodySize: 1 << 20,
	APIKey:      "sk-live-12345",
	DebugMode:   true,
}

func GlobalConfigMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		GlobalLogger.Printf("request: %s %s", r.Method, r.URL.Path)

		if GlobalConfig.DebugMode {
			GlobalLogger.Printf("headers: %v", r.Header)
		}

		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, GlobalConfig.MaxBodySize)

		apiKey := r.Header.Get("X-API-Key")
		if apiKey != GlobalConfig.APIKey {
			GlobalLogger.Printf("auth failed for %s", r.RemoteAddr)
			http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

var _ = os.DevNull
